AM10: FAIL. PLAN-HVPIPELINE-001 faithfully derives its principal phases and gates from section 20, is high priority, NOT APPROVED and unfinished, and explicitly preserves code freeze, operator approval, independent operator-named HV, Nuke gates with zero failures/skips and the four-phase requirements/interfaces-and-stubs/mock-TDD/implementation order. No implementation is authorized. It nevertheless inherits the incompatible finalization contract and leaves its promised artifact repairs without their units/tests. H1 versus later real-host/live-stream acceptance and H5/H6 activation remain unproven (U02). An accurate projection of an incomplete architecture is not an executable plan.

AM11: PASS. Section 20.2 explicitly runs build, test and deployment through Nuke, releases through Octopus, and excludes GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines from gates. H0/H1 and adapter/plugin design use PowerShell for scripts; C# product commands are not scripts. Integration/live reviewer checks use a separate temporary server, never the shared live server. AM12: UNKNOWN. SPDX Apache-2.0 header, zero en/em dash characters, and zero Markdown tables pass. All nine effort commits change only the amendment and carry the required ClaudeCode model/effort/confidence signature. Scans of each reviewed document version, commit message and both plugin-read TODOs found no current marker credential or API-key literal. Local/remote HEAD match. Recorded push ancestry is fast-forward; the absence of a force flag in every actual command cannot be proven from those reflogs. F01: FAIL. The output activity has no independent flush timer. Classification: implementer edit.
Location: docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1395; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1425; FR-MCP-HVPIPE-008-AC001; FR-MCP-HVPIPE-008-AC003.
The live flush prose promises a maximum interval, but StreamReviewerOutput only tests that interval after a new line (amendment 1395, 1425-1437). A small line followed by silence never triggers an append. FR-MCP-HVPIPE-008-AC001 and AC003 reject this trace. The activity and sequence need a timer-triggered flush independently of line arrival.

F02: FAIL. Notification cursor, inbox and delivery are not crash-consistent. Classification: implementer edit.
Location: docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1453; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1471; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1480; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:2200; FR-MCP-HVPIPE-017; FR-MCP-HVPIPE-020.
WatchHvNotifications persists its cursor and inbox in two files (1471), while its diagram claims one atomic replacement (1480). A crash after cursor advancement loses the notification. A fast completion can also be consumed before SubmitHvFromPlugin records its returned request in submitted (1453, 1461), then permanently ignored. UC-HV-07 (2200) promises exactly-once model delivery, contrary to the at-least-once rule and with no atomic delivery acknowledgment. The design needs a single recoverable cursor/inbox state and submission reconciliation, explicit deduplication and honest delivery guarantees, plus crash and fast-completion criteria.

F03: FAIL. Configuration changes do not schedule the promised NONCE. Classification: implementer edit.
Location: docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:632; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:941; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1372; FR-MCP-HVPIPE-001-AC005; FR-MCP-HVPIPE-003.
UpdateHvReviewerCommand promises automatic NONCE after a configuration change (632), but HvWorkerHost requests NONCE only at startup (1372-1389). The claim path consumes only ProbeRequestedUtc (941), which update does not set. The promise needs a durable configuration-change probe request and polling/restart coverage.

F04: FAIL. An old probe can qualify a new reviewer configuration. Classification: implementer edit.
